procedures.rule: Owner runtime is the acceptance gate.
Do not report fixed without exact behavior proof and identified owner-runtime evidence.
procedures.requiredEvidence: Owner report status and runtime-proof field
procedures.failureMessage: Fix claim lacks exact evidence or runtime-proof identification.

procedures.rule: Every owner report must map to an allowed status.
procedures.failureMessage: Owner report mapping or status is missing or invalid.

procedures.rule: Behavioral tests are required when feasible; source-string checks alone are insufficient.
procedures.failureMessage: Behavioral evidence is missing for a feasible behavior claim.

procedures.rule: Every crash requires fresh support-package inspection before a fix packet.
Every noticeable long-running user operation uses universal TPM progress.
procedures.failureMessage: Universal progress audit is missing or incomplete.

procedures.rule: Progress paths must be inventoried path by path.
procedures.failureMessage: A required progress path is unclassified.

procedures.rule: User-facing production paths must not use PowerShell blue progress.
procedures.failureMessage: Write-Progress is present in a user-facing production path.

procedures.rule: Raw web-progress UI and old ad hoc progress strings are forbidden.
procedures.failureMessage: Raw web progress or a banned legacy progress string remains.

procedures.rule: Prompt choices shown must match choices accepted.
procedures.failureMessage: Prompt choices are not reconciled with accepted input.

procedures.rule: Back means Back to the documented parent screen.
procedures.failureMessage: Back routing evidence is missing or contradictory.

procedures.rule: Cancel and Skip must not mutate state.
Preview must not mutate state.
Mutation requires explicit confirmation.
procedures.failureMessage: Explicit mutation confirmation evidence is missing.

procedures.rule: Repair flows are scoped to affected games, never the whole library.
Scoped repair must not trigger unrelated optional flows.
Support manifests surface recent fatal workflow evidence when metadata is unavailable.
procedures.failureMessage: Fatal workflow fallback evidence is missing.

procedures.rule: Support packages include the newest Action Required report when available.
procedures.failureMessage: Newest Action Required evidence is missing.

procedures.rule: Stale support evidence is labeled stale.
Controls readiness remains truthful and never claims verification without evidence.
User-facing wording is beginner-friendly.
Technical terms are accurate and explained.
No commit, push, package, wiki, release, certification, or ARCADE action occurs without explicit authorization.
Monitor-pipeline work must not be mixed into PR #321.
Generated artifacts must not remain unless explicitly intended.
Every changed hunk maps to an owner report, issue, procedure, or authorized requirement.
Fixing a pattern in one place requires auditing the same pattern everywhere.
